description: Error chain: SEA --agent resolves a cloud tier instead of local-first routing. The inference request base_url points to a cloud endpoint (not .201:8000) when local-first is configured. OMN-12660.
trigger: routing policy selects cloud tier despite local-first policy being configured

observable_event.invariant_violated: base_url must match local-first endpoint pattern (not cloud provider)

failure_mode: Inference routed to cloud endpoint → 404 or empty response → empty content emitted as success envelope
regression_guard: Any delegation inference request where base_url is a cloud tier URL while local-first is configured must route to error path, not success
